note: The Credit Information Bureau's own pages (cib.gov.mv), read 2026-10-30. Its home page says member institutions submit credit information every month, with no stated threshold, written as 30 days. Its FAQ says the credit report shows credit history for the past five years because the bureau keeps credit history records for five years, written as a late payment staying five years. The Credit Information Regulation (2022/R-120) itself wasn't reached.

sources.title: Credit Information Bureau (Maldives Monetary Authority): home page, "What we do"
sources.said: Member institutions securely submit credit information to CIB every month.

sources.title: Credit Information Bureau (Maldives Monetary Authority): FAQ's
sources.said: How long does my credit information remain on the CIB Credit Report? ... The Credit Report displays credit history for the past five (5) years, as CIB retains credit history records for a period of five years.
